description:
Create a non-destructive lattice deformation setup for 3D text.

1. Create a Text object with the content "GALAXY".
2. Extrude the text geometry so it has depth (Geometry > Extrude > 0.1 or higher).
3. Create a Lattice object and scale/position it to fully enclose the text.
4. Increase the Lattice resolution (U, V, W) to at least 3 so it has enough control points.
5. Apply a Lattice Modifier to the Text object and set the Object target to your Lattice.
6. Select the Lattice, enter Edit Mode, and move control points to visibly warp/deform the text (e.g., a taper or bulge effect).
7. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/lattice_warp.blend'.
